verdict.rationale: Salv Cases documents opening a case and attaching related alerts, customers and transactions, with notes, documents, an assignee and a status. The case then appears on every linked entity, which covers the grouping part of the story well. Alert prioritization is not documented: the pack shows alert triage aids (auto-closing clearance rules, suppression intervals, informational AI adjudication), but no priority scoring, ranking or queue ordering. Missing for 10: documented alert prioritization (priority scores, risk-based ranking or ordered queues), independent or hands-on corroboration of the case workflow.

support.subject: As a risk-analyst, I can prioritize alerts and group relevant subjects and transactions into an investigation

citations.quote: Open a case, attach the related alerts, customers and transactions, and work it with notes, documents, an assignee and a status
The case then shows on every customer, counterparty, payment and alert it touches, so anyone opening that customer sees the investigation already under way.
